summary: Santa Fe v1: backend (16/16 pytest passing) and frontend E2E all core flows working. Found 1 UI bug (mobile qty controls overlapped by fixed bottom bar) and 1 UX gap (ViaCEP invalid CEP treated as 'CEP não encontrado' but the message only appears when erro:true; when logradouro is empty for a partial CEP, the flow just silently keeps street blank — user won't know why continue-to-summary is disabled).

ui_bugs.issue: Fixed bottom bar with 'Continuar' button (data-testid=continue-to-form) overlaps qty-increase/qty-decrease buttons on 390x844 mobile viewport. Users cannot increase quantity — clicks are intercepted by the bottom bar. Verified: qty-increase bounding box y=477-533 vs continue-to-form container y≈486-542. Playwright reports 'continue-to-form ... subtree intercepts pointer events'. Real mobile users will silently press 'Continuar' when trying to tap +.

integration_issues.issue: For CEPs that ViaCEP returns with erro:true (e.g. 58038101 used in the test spec is invalid), cep-error 'CEP não encontrado' shows but continue button stays disabled without a clear hint. Consider a fallback where user can manually fill address if ViaCEP is down/CEP not found. Note: the review spec's suggested CEP 58038101 is NOT valid — use 58038100 or 58013000.

action_items: FIX HIGH: Add bottom padding to OrderFlow step-1 card (e.g., pb-32) OR move qty controls above the fixed bar / add mb-24 to the card content so qty +/- buttons aren't hidden behind the sticky Continuar bar on mobile.
UX: In OrderFlow, when city is missing/street is empty after ViaCEP autofill, show a hint '(preencha o endereço manualmente)' and enable manual address entry.
DOC: Update review spec — CEP 58038101 is invalid on ViaCEP; use 58038100/58013000 for João Pessoa test data.

server.py cookie set with secure=True/samesite=none — appropriate for cross-site preview URL ✓

OrderFlow.jsx handleCep: if ViaCEP returns empty logradouro (some CEPs), street stays empty silently — no user hint that manual entry is needed. Minor UX gap.
OrderFlow.jsx step 1 fixed bottom bar overlaps card content on small viewports — see UI bug above.

rca of the issue: UI qty overlap: /app/frontend/src/pages/OrderFlow.jsx step 1 renders quantity controls inside a card that shares vertical space with a fixed bottom bar (`fixed bottom-0 ... p-4`) containing the 'Continuar' button. On 390x844 the card's inner qty buttons render at y≈477-533 while the fixed bar starts at y≈486, so the bar overlays the +/− controls and captures pointer events (Playwright confirms 'continue-to-form subtree intercepts pointer events'). Fix: add `pb-24` (or `mb-24`) to the step-1 card wrapper OR reduce card content height / render qty controls above the fold.
